name: Write Conversion Copy
summary: Write persuasive page copy from audience evidence, product truth, objections, and one primary action.
description: Write website or landing-page copy from verified product facts, customer language, decision context, objections, and a defined action. Use when a new page or substantial rewrite needs persuasive structure without invented proof or manipulative claims.
refuses: It does not fabricate customers, quotes, awards, results, guarantees, or urgency.
It does not use fear, shame, hidden costs, or ambiguous controls to force action.
It does not claim a conversion outcome without measurement evidence.
